issue.title: Mac pom glossary strand describes a stale NO POMODORO flash schedule
issue.description:
The `NO POMODORO` sentence in this strand is stale and should be rewritten to match the chezmoi README "Pomodoro menu bar" section, which is the mac pom spec.

Current text: "...which flashes as a green pill for its first minute on screen and then for one minute in every ten, restarting that cycle whenever the label reappears or the Mac wakes or unlocks."

Why it is wrong:

1. chezmoi commit 39f24434 (`feat(hammerspoon): flash NO POMODORO green every five minutes`, plan:202610/no_pomodoro_five_minute_flash.md) changed `MISSING_REMINDER_EVERY_SECONDS` from 600 to 300. That plan deliberately left this strand alone, so "one minute in every ten" has been wrong since then.
2. A follow-up tale proposed on 2026-10-06 (`sase_plan_no_pomodoro_delayed_first_flash.md`) keeps the label steady for its first minute on screen, flashes it for the second minute, and then keeps the existing one-minute-every-five-minutes windows. Those windows start at 5:00, 10:00, and so on after the label appears.

Proposed wording, once that tale has landed (check the chezmoi README first):

"...which stays steady for its first minute on screen, flashes as a green pill for its second minute, and then flashes for one minute every five minutes, counted from when it appeared. The cycle restarts whenever the label reappears or the Mac wakes or unlocks."

If that tale was rejected, describe the shipped behavior instead: "...for its first minute on screen and then for one minute in every five...".

issue.creation_reason: The mac pom glossary strand still says the NO POMODORO pill flashes one minute in every ten, but chezmoi now flashes every five minutes. A pending tale also moves the first flash to the second minute, and memory edits were not authorized in that plan.

evidence.note: Independent report 2026-10-06: the strand still says 'one minute in every ten'; chezmoi pomodoro_countdown.lua currently flashes 1:00-2:00 then 1 min every 5 (MISSING_REMINDER_EVERY_SECONDS=300, FIRST_AFTER=60). A new tale (sase_plan_mac_pom_fibonacci_reminders.md) replaces that cadence with Fibonacci rests (1m, 1m, 2m, 3m, 5m, 8m, ... uncapped) between 60-second flash steps, and the label reads 'NO POMODORO φ 5m' during a step. Once it lands, rewrite the sentence from the chezmoi README 'Pomodoro menu bar' section, roughly: '...which rests for Fibonacci-many minutes (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, ...) between one-minute green-pill flash steps, showing the rest just taken as NO POMODORO φ Nm during each step, and restarts at φ 1m whenever the label reappears or the Mac wakes or unlocks.' If that tale is rejected, use the bead's existing five-minute wording.

Use the Fibonacci wording from the previous +1. Bead bob-cli-57 covers the same strand's polling sentence, so one worker should refresh both from the chezmoi README 'Pomodoro menu bar' section. A new tale (sase_plan_mac_pom_overdue_minute_pulse.md, proposed 2026-10-08) will also make the overdue sentence stale. If it lands, change 'the +MM:SS count turns red' to say the red count also flashes at 1 Hz while its seconds read :00 to :05 each minute (+00:01 to +00:05, then +01:00 to +01:05, and so on), before the continuously flashing OVERDUE badge from ten minutes overdue.

payload.entry: The overdue minute pulse is now the first ten seconds, not five. When refreshing glossary:mac-menu-bar-pomodoro-indicator from the chezmoi README Pomodoro menu bar section, say the red +MM:SS count flashes at 1 Hz for +00:01 through +00:10 and then +MM:00 through +MM:10 each minute, and holds steady red from :11, until the continuously flashing OVERDUE badge at ten minutes. The 2026-10-08 +1's :00 to :05 wording is superseded. Do not revive the five-second window.
